Marta (People Ops): Quick Q from Leo: we approved an out-of-cycle promotion (L2 -> L3) effective 2026-06-01. Payroll cutoff passed. Do we automatically retro, and what should go in the employee comms?
Leo (Eng Manager): Approval landed 2026-05-28. IC expects new salary next paycheck; manager prefers retro. Want to avoid confusion on payslip.
Jo (Comp): Standard is retro to effective date unless manager requests delay and comp signs off. For equity: small one-time RSU allowed; label as OFFCYCLE_ONE_TIME.
Kofi (Payroll): Confirming: retro is possible. We need CSV with columns: employee_id, name, old_annual, new_annual, eff_date, comp_ticket, approver. Example row:
```
44501,Sam Q,98000,110000,2026-06-01,CC-OC-2026-05-28,Jo M
```
comp-bot: Reminder: attach manager justification + benchmarks to ticket CC-OC-2026-05-28 for audit trail.
Marta (People Ops): For comms: suggest "effective June 1; a retro payment may appear mid-June if approval posted after payroll cutoff. Payslip will show retro and current pay lines." Any preferred phrasing?
Jo (Comp): That phrasing is good. Add a note about bonus proration if promotion changes target.
Leo (Eng Manager): Ok we'll go retro. I'll add the manager note and post the CSV + Workday change ID here when ready.
Kofi (Payroll): Once we get CSV I'll validate GL mapping and confirm expected posting date (usually next payroll cycle).
Marta (People Ops): Thanks all ":white_check_mark:"
